name: Display name
size_hint: 0 disables uploads. PHP and web-server limits still apply.
directory_hint: Relative to storage/app. Public access requires a web-server mapping; use the built-in public storage for existing /storage URLs.
r2_hint: R2: region auto. Public images need a connected custom domain or a development r2.dev URL. This setting does not make the bucket public.
storage_hint: Credentials are encrypted and never returned. Changing the default only affects new uploads; existing file addresses stay unchanged.
sync_hint: One-way copy of registered files only; retains the source and current URLs. SHA-256 verifies copies. Conflicting objects are not overwritten. Private files cannot be copied to public storage.
sync_confirm: Copy registered files to the selected storage? Source files and existing image addresses will be retained.
worker_hint: The queue worker must be running:
file_copy_failed: Copy failed. Check source availability, target credentials, visibility and checksum conflicts, then retry.
worker_failed: Worker failed or timed out. Check the queue worker and retry.
storage_disabled: Source or target storage is disabled.
visibility_mismatch: Source and target visibility do not match.
destination_conflict: A different file already exists at the target path; it was not overwritten.
source_checksum_mismatch: Source contents do not match the registered checksum.
